description: End-to-end noiseless QPSK links checked against the channel's own delay, offset and phase (conventions: QPSK link).

cases.source: noiseless link: the first symbol peaks at y[L-1+delay] = y[43] with L = 41 taps, so tau = 3 and the frame starts 10 symbols in (conventions: QPSK link); no errors

noiseless link: the channel's own offset, and its carrier phase at the middle of the first pulse, phase + 2 pi df (delay + (L-1)/2)/fs wrapped into (-pi, pi]; within 0.01 for inter-symbol interference from truncated taps and an offset applied before the matched filter
noiseless link: the first symbol peaks at y[L-1+delay] = y[86] with L = 81 taps, so tau = 6 and the frame starts 10 symbols in (conventions: QPSK link); no errors

noiseless link: the first symbol peaks at y[L-1+delay] = y[25] with L = 25 taps, so tau = 1 and the frame starts 6 symbols in (conventions: QPSK link); no errors

noiseless link: the channel's own offset, and its carrier phase at the middle of the first pulse, phase + 2 pi df (delay + (L-1)/2)/fs wrapped into (-pi, pi]; within 0.01 for inter-symbol interference from truncated taps and an offset applied before the matched filter; 0.1 here: one block means no fine estimate, only the coarse one over 40 symbols
